deskyard computer access: show or change who may use a computer (admin)

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] computer access NAME [USER=LEVEL]...

Without assignments, lists the accounts with access to the computer and their
level. With them, changes the named accounts (none removes the access) and
keeps the others; a lowered or removed access closes that account's
connections at once. Administrators always have full access; shares are
managed with `deskyard share`.

Arguments:
  NAME       string      required  computer name
  ASSIGNMENT string...   optional  USER=LEVEL: USER=full, USER=observe or USER=none

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text
  --server NAME        the server to manage (see `deskyard server list`);
                       default: the server -c SERVER/COMPUTER names, else the
                       default server

Prints: without assignments a table USER LEVEL (with --json the API's Computer
  object, whose access field lists them); with them a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard computer access alice
  deskyard computer access alice anna=full bob=observe carl=none

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
